name: Triglycerides
rangeNote: This range is for a fasting sample. Triglycerides rise for several hours after a meal.
summary: Triglycerides are the main type of fat in the blood. The body uses them for energy and stores extra calories as triglycerides.

high.meaning: High triglycerides are linked with heart risk and, when very high, with pancreatitis.
commonCauses: Diet high in sugar and refined carbohydrates

low.meaning: Low triglycerides are generally not a concern.

biologicalVariation.population: 11 healthy adults aged 21–50 in Spain, fasting samples once a week for 5 weeks; the lab's own imprecision removed

source.title: Biological variation of metabolic cardiovascular risk factors in haemodialysis patients and healthy individuals.

sources.title: 2019 ESC/EAS Guidelines for the management of dyslipidaemias: lipid modification to reduce cardiovascular risk
